scholarships.provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships
scholarships.description: Türkiye Scholarships is a comprehensive, government-funded scholarship program that provides university and department placement, tuition fees, a 1-year Turkish language course, accommodation support, a one-off flight ticket, health insurance, and a monthly stipend for international students at associate, bachelor’s, master’s, and doctorate levels.

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships
scholarships.description: Türkiye Scholarships offers various long-term bachelor's, master's, and PhD scholarships, as well as short-term research and merit-based scholarships, and joint scholarship programs.

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships – Sabancı University PURE Summer Research Program 2026
scholarships.description: This 7-week program provides outstanding undergraduate students with a unique summer research experience at Sabancı University. Benefits include a monthly stipend of 13,000 TL, round-trip flight ticket, accommodation, tuition fee coverage, and social/cultural activities.

scholarships.title: YTB – Islamic Development Bank (ISDB) Joint Scholarship Program
scholarships.provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) and the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB)
scholarships.description: The Türkiye Scholarships – IsDB Joint Scholarship Program is co-funded by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) and the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB). The program aims to enable high-achieving students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities living in other countries to receive education at internationally recognized standards at prestigious universities in Türkiye.

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships 2026
scholarships.description: Türkiye Scholarships is a government-funded, competitive scholarship program for international students to pursue full-time or short-term programs at top universities in Türkiye. The scholarship includes financial support, tuition fees, accommodation, health insurance, and university placement.

scholarships.title: International Student Academy
scholarships.description: The International Student Academy is a set of programs aimed at strengthening the academic, social and cultural lives of international students studying at higher education institutions in Türkiye. Programs include Seminar Programs, Specialization Programs, Cultural and Art Programs, and Online Programs.

scholarships.title: International Student Academy
scholarships.description: The International Student Academy is a set of programs aimed at strengthening the academic, social and cultural lives of international students studying at higher education institutions in Turkey, consisting of Seminar Programs, Specialization Programs, Cultural and Art Programs, and Online Programs.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships help build prosperity, security, and sustainable growth in partner countries and foster a lifetime connection to Aotearoa New Zealand. The programme offers full academic scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate study, as well as short-term training scholarships.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships include full academic scholarships and short term training opportunities for international students to study in New Zealand.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Full tertiary scholarships for eligible international students from developing countries to study fulltime at a New Zealand or Pacific education institution. The programme also includes short-term training scholarships for vocational skills, thematic cohort training, and English language training for government officials.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme provides funding for international students to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate study at universities and institutes of technology in New Zealand. The program includes specific streams such as Thematic Short Term Training, Vocational Short Term Training, and English Language Training for Officials.

scholarships.title: Thematic Short Term Training Scholarships
scholarships.description: Short-term professional training scholarships for mid and senior-level professionals to build knowledge and skills in various sectors, delivered by reputable education institutions in New Zealand or online.

scholarships.title: Vocational Short Term Training Scholarships
scholarships.description: The New Zealand Government offers Vocational Short Term Training Scholarships to fund skills training and work experience for professionals from eligible countries. Scholars can undertake a training course with a New Zealand certified training provider, a work placement, or participate in an online or in-country training course.

scholarships.title: English Language Training for Officials Scholarships
scholarships.description: The New Zealand Government offers scholarships to government officials from eligible African and Asian countries to come to New Zealand for English language training. The program is specifically for government officials and follows a nomination process through the New Zealand Embassy or High Commission rather than direct applications.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme provides funding for students from eligible Pacific and Asian countries to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate studies in New Zealand or at specific Pacific universities. The program is limited to citizens from identified eligible nations and includes various study levels ranging from certificates to PhDs.

scholarships.title: Samoa Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Samoa Foundation scholarship provides funding for eligible applicants to study in New Zealand. Applications open midnight 4 August 2026 and close midday 4 September 2026.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are offered to citizens from eligible developing countries to undertake study in New Zealand or the Pacific. The scholarships provide funding for education to enable scholars to contribute to their home country's social and economic development.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide opportunities for international students from eligible countries to undertake undergraduate and postgraduate study in New Zealand. The selection process is highly competitive and involves screening, psychometric testing, assessment of academic and work experience, and online video interviews. Scholars are expected to return to their home countries for at least two years after completing their studies to contribute to social and economic development.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide funding for students from eligible regions and countries to study in New Zealand. Applicants are encouraged to select subjects based on the social and economic needs of their home country.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship provides funding for international students from eligible countries to undertake undergraduate or postgraduate study in New Zealand. This page outlines the administrative process for individuals who have been selected as preferred candidates, including admission requirements and scholarship acceptance procedures.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide funding for undergraduate and postgraduate study at approved education institutions in New Zealand and specific universities in the Pacific. The scholarships are available to citizens from eligible regions and countries, with a focus on subjects aligned with the social and economic needs of the applicant's country.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship provides funding for international students to study in New Zealand. It covers full tuition fees, living allowances, establishment costs, medical insurance, and travel. Recipients must meet specific academic and conduct requirements and follow scholarship policies.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.description: The JJ/WBGSP enables mid-career professionals from developing countries and Japan to complete graduate degrees in development-related fields.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.description: The JJ/WBGSP offers scholarships for 44 Participating Master’s Programs in 24 universities for citizens of developing countries with professional experience in development-related fields. Scholars commit to returning to their home country after graduation to contribute to social and economic development.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) - Japanese Nationals
scholarships.description: The JJ/WBGSP provides scholarships for Japanese mid-career professionals who are dedicated to the alleviation of poverty and enhanced shared prosperity in developing countries, and who have been admitted to or are currently enrolled in a master’s or PhD graduate degree program outside of Japan.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.provider: Government of Japan and the World Bank
scholarships.description: The Joint Japan/World Bank Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) was established to strengthen human resources in developing countries by providing scholarships to help aspiring practitioners and leaders enhance their expertise and skill levels to contribute to policy reform and economic growth.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.description: The Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) provides scholarships for developing country nationals and Japanese nationals to pursue graduate studies at universities around the world.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.description: Since 1987, JJ/WBGSP has enabled more than 7,000 mid-career professionals from 160 developing countries and Japan to complete graduate degrees in development-related fields. The program is funded by the Government of Japan.

scholarships.title: Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program
scholarships.description: The Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program (RSMFP) matches aspiring development economics researchers from developing countries with World Bank research economists to participate in rigorous policy-relevant research in the World Bank’s Development Economics Vice Presidency (DEC). Fellows are hosted at the World Bank in Washington, D.C.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) Participating Programs
scholarships.description: The JJ/WBGSP provides scholarships for graduate studies in selected master's programs at participating universities around the world. These programs are specifically aligned with the World Bank's mission of promoting shared prosperity and reducing poverty.

scholarships.title: RISE Germany
scholarships.description: RISE Germany offers undergraduate students from British and Irish universities the opportunity to complete a summer research internship at top German universities and research institutions.

scholarships.title: Mechanics of Sustainable Materials and Structures (MS²) EMJM Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Mechanics of Sustainable Materials and Structures (MS²) program is a joint program between Germany, Italy, and France. It offers Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) scholarships for top international students.

scholarships.title: SI Baltic Sea and Eastern Partnership Programme
scholarships.description: Funding for cooperation between Swedish actors and organisations in the Baltic Sea region and the EU’s Eastern Partnership countries.

scholarships.title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme provides funding for international students to pursue higher education studies in Hungary. The scholarship includes various provisions such as tuition-free education, monthly stipends, and accommodation contributions, subject to the programme's operational regulations.

scholarships.title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Stipendium Hungaricum Programme is a scholarship programme for international students that covers studies in Hungary, providing a monthly stipend and accommodation contribution for full-time degree programmes.

scholarships.title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship offers tuition-free education, a monthly stipend, accommodation contribution, and medical insurance for students pursuing bachelor’s, master’s, one-tier master’s, doctoral, or non-degree programmes in Hungary.

scholarships.title: Aichi Scholarship Program [Pre-Arrival Admission]
scholarships.description: A scholarship program provided by the Aichi Prefectural Government for international students applying for Master's degree programs or graduate research student status.

scholarships.title: JJ/WBGSP Participating Programs 2026 — Application Window #1
scholarships.description: The Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) supports graduate studies at specific participating programs. Application Window #1 for 2026 covers designated Master's programs at various universities including Brandeis University, Columbia University, Johns Hopkins University, KIT/Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, UC-Berkeley, University of Tokyo, University of Tsukuba, Williams College, and Yale University.

scholarships.title: JJ/WBGSP Participating Programs 2026 — Application Window #2
scholarships.description: The JJ/WBGSP offers scholarships for citizens of developing countries to pursue graduate studies in selected programs at partner universities around the world. Application Window #2 for the 2026 academic year is open from March 30 to May 29, 2026.

scholarships.title: RISE (Research Internships in Science and Engineering) Germany
scholarships.description: Research Internships in Science and Engineering (RISE) Germany offers undergraduate students the opportunity to complete a research internship at a German university or research institution.

scholarships.title: Research Grants DAAD
scholarships.description: Research grants for PhD students and researchers ranging from short time periods (up to six months) to one year grants for conducting research in Germany.

scholarships.title: Make Our Planet Great Again, Master’s excellence grants
scholarships.provider: France’s ministries of Europe and foreign affairs (MEAE) and of higher education and research (MESR)
scholarships.description: Excellence grants for international students pursuing master’s-level training in earth systems, climate change and sustainability, or the energy transition at French institutions. The grant includes a monthly stipend of €1,060, round-trip airfare, medical insurance, and an annual payment for educational expenses.

scholarships.title: MOPGA Fellowships (Make Our Planet Great Again)
scholarships.provider: Campus France, French Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs, and Ministry of Higher Education and Research
scholarships.description: The MOPGA fellowship program supports cutting-edge scientific projects addressing issues related to the environment and climate change. It facilitates the mobility of early career international researchers to promote collaboration with leading French research institutions.

scholarships.title: MOPGA 2026: Visiting Fellowship Program for Early Career Researchers
scholarships.provider: Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE)
fields: Societal challenges related to environmental issues
scholarships.description: The Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) initiative is a postdoctoral mobility program for early career researchers to conduct a 12-month research project in France focused on environmental and climate issues. Eligible applicants must hold a doctoral degree obtained between December 2020 and December 2025 and must not hold French citizenship.

scholarships.title: YTB-IsDB Joint Scholarship Program 2025
scholarships.description: The YTB-IsDB Joint Scholarship Program offers scholarships to students and scholars from IsDB member countries to pursue studies at prestigious universities in Türkiye. For associate and bachelor’s degrees, the scholarship is provided as an interest-free loan (Qard-Hasan) that is repayable after graduation.

scholarships.title: YTB–IsDB Joint Scholarship Program
scholarships.provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) and Islamic Development Bank (IsDB)
scholarships.description: A joint scholarship program established in cooperation between the YTB and the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) for international students to study in Türkiye.

scholarships.title: Visiting Fellowship Program for Young Researchers (MOPGA 4)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE) and Ministry of Higher Education and Research (MESR)
scholarships.description: A visiting fellowship program for young researchers (holding a PhD for less than 5 years) to carry out research in France within a 'One Health' approach. Benefits include a monthly allowance of 2,500 euros, a moving allowance, and support for social security and health insurance.

scholarships.title: JJ/WBGSP Scholarship
scholarships.description: A list of countries eligible for the Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) in 2027.

scholarships.title: MOPGA (Make Our Planet Great Again) funding programs
scholarships.description: The Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) program offers various funding opportunities including master's excellence grants, doctoral contracts, and visiting fellowship programs for early career researchers to conduct research in France in fields related to climate change and environmental issues.

scholarships.title: Make Our Planet Great Again - Master’s excellence grants
scholarships.provider: France’s ministries of Europe and foreign affairs (MEAE) and of higher education and research (MESR) in collaboration with Campus France
scholarships.description: Excellence grants for international students to pursue master’s-level training in earth systems, climate change, energy transition, or societal challenges of environmental issues at French institutions of higher education.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
scholarships.description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is a tool developed by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to enroll in their master's and PhD programs.
